column1: # Upstream base images, pinned by digest. The single source of truth for what
# every derived image is built FROM.
# Digests were resolved from the live registries during step 1 research and are
# recorded in DESIGN.md section 3. Every entry is confirmed linux/amd64 +
# linux/arm64. Renovate raises the bumps; never edit a tag without its digest.
# MongoDB is SSPL: source-available, NOT OSI open source. A derived image is
# permitted but must be labelled. See docs/licensing.md and SPEC section 22.5.
# Not an engine: the Go toolchain the gotools stage rebuilds gosu, rclone and
# postgres_exporter on (DESIGN.md D-51). scripts/build passes it as GO_IMAGE, and
# check 02 fails if a Dockerfile's GO_IMAGE default disagrees with this row.
